facts.business: Samsrita Labs Limited appears to be a company with minimal operations, reporting revenue of Rs 1.81 lakhs and significant losses, with references to intangible assets, patents, and associate companies.

auditor.name: M/s MGR & Co
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Acquisition of intangible asset and write-off of existing intangible asset due to technological obsolescence (Note 3); 2) Security deposit balance fully settled towards acquisition of new patent (Note 5); 3) Substantial reduction in trade receivables due to write-off of bad debts (Note 7). Opinion not modified.

key_risks: Technological obsolescence leading to write-off of intangible assets
Bad debts requiring write-off of trade receivables
Sustained losses with minimal revenue generation
Dependence on associate companies for consolidated performance
